newsitem.title: UK: NatWest arranges 200 mln stg deal for Vendcrown.
newsitem.headline: NatWest arranges 200 mln stg deal for Vendcrown.

text.p: NatWest Markets has arranged a 200 million stg securitised transaction to finance Vendcrown Ltd's acquisition of Premium Credit Ltd, NatWest said on Tuesday.
The deal was done through Thames Asset Global Securitization No. 1 Inc (TAGS), a multi-seller asset-backed commercial paper vehicle sponsored and administered by NatWest Markets, the statement said.
TAGS issues dollar commercial paper under a $2.0 billion CP programme, and this is its ninth transaction, NatWest said.
The financing is the first time a securitisation has been used as the primary source of funding for a private equity acquisition in Europe, it added.
Vendcrown is controlled by Electra Fleming Ltd. Premium Credit was formed in 1988 to provide insurance premium instalment financing services, NatWest said.
